hypothesis: Retaining the complete audit trace and exposing a compact JSON receipt reduces visible UTF-8 bytes by at least 80% while preserving the exact branch inventory partition, every ancestry-unmerged ref and each unmerged ref's git-cherry classification.
limitations: The full overhead boundary includes audit execution, receipt construction, trace/report maintenance, required tests, documentation, checkpoint refresh and publication verification, but only command-output bytes are directly comparable. One fresh clone and branch inventory cannot establish effects on comprehension, tokens, latency, total session effort, general-agent performance or LLM quality.
